# Heavy Aircraft Research

Section: Research Path > Unlocked by

## Heavy Aircraft

[![Heavyaircraftresearch](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/4/40/Heavyaircraftresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421185837)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/4/40/Heavyaircraftresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421185837)

### Research Points

30

### Research Time

2h 10m

## Research Path

### Unlocked by

[Helicopters](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Helicopters_Research), [Planes](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Planes_Research)

Heavy aircraft is a [researchable](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research) item which unlocks the following components:

| Category | Component |
| --- | --- |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Wing Section (Large) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Wing Section (XLarge) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Wing Section (XXLarge) |
| Specialist Equipment | Vehicle Parachute |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Control Surface (Large) |
| [Propulsion](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Propulsion) | Rotor (Large) |
| [Propulsion](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Propulsion) | Rotor Propeller (Large) |
| [Propulsion](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Propulsion) | Rotor Propeller End (Large) |
